Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Cyrus Broacha is joined by acclaimed filmmaker and advertising director Mahesh Mathai, whose series Real Kashmir Football Club has earned a nomination at the International Emmy Awards 2026.
Mahesh takes us behind the making of ‘Real Kashmir Football Club’, sharing stories of shooting in Kashmir, working with actors Manav Kaul and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, and bringing an inspiring true story of football, resilience and community to the screen.
